points.description: States that the best-case number of operations for insertion sort is N, the length of the array (equivalent forms such as 'n comparisons/operations' or 'linear, O(N)' earn the mark).
States that the best case is when the array is already sorted (equivalent wording such as 'input already in ascending order' earns the mark).

rubric.notes: Full marks (5) for stating both that the best-case operation count is N, the array length, and that the best case is an already-sorted array. Award 2 for the operation count alone and 3 for the sorted-array condition alone; no marks for a worst-case description such as a reverse-sorted array. Do not require the exact phrasing of the model answer.
